protocol.name: virtual_keyboard_unstable_v1
protocol.description: A description of the wire format of the protocol virtual-keyboard-unstable-v1, which wlroots compositors implement, written for Magpie: the interfaces, requests and arguments in the order the compositors expect them. It is not packaged with wayland-protocols or wlr-protocols, so it is kept here.

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1

description.summary: a keyboard whose keys a client presses

interface.description: The seat it was made for gets the keys as if from a real keyboard.

request.name: keymap

description.summary: the keymap the key codes refer to

request.description: As wl_keyboard.keymap has it: a format of wl_keyboard.keymap_format, a file with the keymap and the size of that file. Has to be sent before the first key.

request.name: key

description.summary: a key was pressed or released

request.description: As wl_keyboard.key has it: a time in milliseconds, the key code of evdev and a state of wl_keyboard.key_state.

description.summary: the state of the modifiers changed

entry.name: unauthorized
entry.summary: the client may not make virtual keyboards

description.summary: a new virtual keyboard for a seat
